scripts.build:extension: esbuild src/content.tsx src/popup.tsx src/background.ts --bundle --minify --outdir=dist --target=chrome120 --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && tailwindcss -i src/popup.css -o dist/popup.css --minify && cp src/content.css src/manifest.json dist/ && cp -r public/. dist/
scripts.dev: pnpm build:extension && esbuild src/content.tsx src/popup.tsx src/background.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=chrome120 --watch
